description: Attach objects to a discount or detach them. Supported object types: product_variant_ids (variant UUIDs), category_ids (category UUIDs), collection_ids (collection UUIDs). Per request pass EITHER product_variant_ids OR categories/collections — the API does not mix variants with categories/collections.

action.description: Whether to attach or detach the objects.

objects.description: DiscountObjects record: arrays product_variant_ids, category_ids and/or collection_ids (see get_operation_schema("AddDiscountObjects")).

name: manage_discount_objects
title: Add or remove discount objects
